headline: A conditional reliability model shows how shared failures erase nominal AI-control redundancy
summary: An arXiv preprint models one published AI-control deployment route as access control, monitoring plus response, or visibility plus tracing plus containment. Under independent equal rare failures, its visible-component model has six size-three minimal cuts and failure probability asymptotic to 6ε³. Illustrative shared failure domains reduce the minimum underlying cut size to two or one, and a conditional derivation shows why stronger prevention can concentrate later recovery demands in harder failure regimes. The paper recommends explicit dependency mapping and recovery tests that preserve the initiating failure. These results are conditional analysis: the common-cause examples are not claims about Google DeepMind’s implementation, and no operational probabilities are calibrated.
